obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, full-bleed background, link text — the default surface for every screen; nothing sits on a lighter background

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Display type, body text, button fills, hairline borders — the only ink color, used at full saturation with zero tints

concrete.$description: Concrete — Secondary borders, muted list rules, subdued dividers — the single mid-tone for de-emphasized structure

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated nav surfaces and secondary panels — the only step off pure black for distinct UI layers

monospace.$description: Small technical UI text — system monospace at fixed 13px for tags, metadata, or any content that needs a typewriter feel against the sans-serif body

anton.$description: Display and orbital type — the only voice for headings, hero text, and the signature circular compositions. Anton's condensed grotesque geometry lets words like 'BELIEVE' and 'THINKING' become architectural forms; the heavy 500 weight at 90–150px is the design's entire visual identity

montserrat.$description: Body copy, navigation, button labels, list items, subheadings. The 2.78 line-height on the 18px size signals intentional airy rhythm in body blocks; 600 weight reserved for nav emphasis and small heading accents

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
